FM_MISSING_CLOSE.hint: close the frontmatter with --- before the body

FM_UNSUPPORTED_SYNTAX.hint: frontmatter is flat 'key: scalar' lines only; no block lists, block scalars, or nesting (aliases: [a, b] flow lists are the one exception)

FIELD_REQUIRED.hint: add the field the bucket requires

FIELD_UNKNOWN.hint: field not in the bucket schema; add it to the schema or drop it

ENUM_INVALID.hint: value must match the field pattern

STATUS_UNEXPECTED.hint: status is sanctioned but not used in this bucket

TYPE_BUCKET_MISMATCH.hint: type must match the bucket folder

DATE_INVALID.hint: created/last_verified/revisit_by is YYYY-MM-DD and a real date

FILENAME_PATTERN.hint: rename to the bucket convention and update inbound links

BASENAME_DUPLICATE.hint: same basename used in more than one bucket; rename one or qualify every wikilink to it

ADR_TITLE_MISMATCH.hint: H1 should read '# ADR-NNN: <title>' with the file's number

SECTION_ORDER.hint: Context, Decision, Consequences in that order

SUPERSEDED_BY_STRAY.hint: superseded_by set but status is not superseded

BANNER_MISSING.hint: demoted decision needs '> Status:' as the first body line

BANNER_NOT_FIRST.hint: move the '> Status:' line directly under the H1

BANNER_STATUS_MISMATCH.hint: banner keyword must agree with frontmatter status

BANNER_NO_LINK.hint: SUPERSEDED/AMENDED banner should name the note to read instead

AMENDMENT_MISSING.hint: status amended needs a dated '## Amendment' block

SURFACE_MISSING.hint: components end with '## Reusable surface' (entries or 'None - <reason>')

SURFACE_EMPTY.hint: section has neither entries nor a 'None - <reason>' stanza

SURFACE_OUT_OF_SCOPE.hint: bucket does not carry a Reusable surface; link the owning component

SURFACE_PATH_MISSING.hint: listed path no longer exists; repair or drop the entry

SURFACE_SYMBOL_MISSING.hint: symbol not found at the listed path; repair or drop the entry

SURFACE_DUPLICATE_HOME.hint: symbol listed in more than one note; keep one canonical home

SURFACE_REGION_CHANGED.hint: code around this symbol changed since the note last touched it; verify the entry still holds

LINK_AMBIGUOUS.hint: basename exists in several buckets; qualify it as [[bucket/name]]

LINK_INTERNAL_MD.hint: use [[wikilink]] for links between vault notes, not a markdown link

ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED.hint: #heading not found in the target note

ORPHAN_NO_OUTBOUND.hint: note links to no other note

ORPHAN_NO_INBOUND.hint: no other note links to this one

ORPHAN_HUB_ONLY_INBOUND.hint: only a hub links here; link this note from a content note too

EMPTY_NOTE.hint: no content after the H1; add content or delete the note

SIZE_NOTE.hint: note is getting large; consider splitting it

SIZE_NOTE_LIMIT.hint: note exceeds the hard size limit; split it

SIZE_LINE.hint: line is very long; wrap it

SIZE_HUB.hint: hub is getting large; consider trimming or splitting

SIZE_HUB_LIMIT.hint: hub exceeds the hard size limit; trim it

SIZE_HUB_LINE.hint: hub line is very long; wrap it

SIZE_HUB_LINE_LIMIT.hint: hub line exceeds the hard limit; wrap it

SIZE_VAULT.hint: vault exceeds the soft budget; consider archiving or splitting buckets

SECRET_DETECTED.hint: looks like a credential or token; remove it and rotate if real

HTML_COMMENT.hint: remove the HTML comment; it can hide instructions from reviewers

INVISIBLE_UNICODE.hint: remove invisible or control unicode characters

REMOTE_IMAGE.hint: avoid remote image embeds; they can leak reader signals

UNTRUSTED_FENCE_NO_SOURCE.hint: add 'source=<url>' to the fence info string or remove it

GUARD_ABSENT.hint: guard-vault-write.sh not found; content classes were skipped

EXCEPTION_STALE.hint: allowlist entry matches nothing; delete it

BUCKET_UNKNOWN.hint: note sits outside every schema bucket

SUPERSEDED_BY_NO_BACKLINK.hint: successor must link back to the note it supersedes

SUPERSESSION_CYCLE.hint: superseded_by chain loops; break the cycle

BANNER_SUCCESSOR_MISMATCH.hint: banner's first [[link]] must be the superseded_by target

SOURCE_COMMIT_UNRESOLVED.hint: commit sha not in this repo

SOURCE_TICKET_PATTERN.hint: ticket id does not match ticket_pattern (override in .vault-lint.json)

BASIS_INFERRED_NO_SOURCES.hint: inferred claims cite at least one source

MARKER_RECHECK_MISSING.hint: pair 'as of DATE' with <!-- recheck YYYY-MM-DD: reason --> on the same line

MARKER_REASON_MISSING.hint: until/deprecated/recheck markers carry a reason after the dash or colon

MARKER_ADR_EVIDENCE.hint: in an ADR, cite the [[note]] or Amendment (date) that set the marker

MARKER_RECHECK_DUE.hint: recheck date has passed; re-verify and move the date

GOVERNS_MISSING.hint: active decisions and constraints list governs: [pathspec, ...] ([] when nothing in-repo)

GOVERNS_FORMAT.hint: governs/applies_to is a flow list [a, b]

APPLIES_TO_DEAD_GLOB.hint: applies_to directory matches nothing at HEAD

HUB_MISSING_FROM_INDEX.hint: heavily linked note; add it to _index.md

GLOSSARY_ENTRY_NO_LINK.hint: glossary entry should link the note that owns the term

RULES_FILE_OVERMATCHED.hint: repo file matched by more than 3 notes; narrow the governs specs

DIGEST_LEGACY.hint: git rm docs/project-knowledge/_digest.md; the digest is regenerated under .cache/

ADR_Y_STATEMENT_MISSING.hint: add y_statement: In the context of .., facing .., we decided .., to achieve .., accepting .. (new ADRs: FAIL)

ADR_Y_STATEMENT_ORDER.hint: y_statement clauses must run: In the context of, facing, we decided, [neglected], to achieve, accepting

ADR_Y_STATEMENT_LENGTH.hint: summarize the rejected options; keep the y_statement short enough that its _index.md line stays under 400 characters

ADR_OPTIONS_MISSING.hint: add ## Considered options, chosen first; an old ADR gets it on its next touch as ## Considered options (recorded YYYY-MM-DD) (new ADRs: FAIL)

ADR_OPTIONS_EMPTY.hint: list the options, or write _Only option: <why>._ or _No alternatives recorded: brief named none._

ADR_OPTIONS_CHOSEN_FIRST.hint: the first bullet under ## Considered options is the chosen one, marked (chosen)

ADR_APPROVED_BY_AGENT.hint: an unattended run approved this ADR; a human handle and date replaces it on review

ADR_OBJECTION_DISPOSITION.hint: every ## Objections considered bullet ends with accepted as cost, rejected: <why>, or deferred: revisit if <condition>

ADR_INDEX_LINE_MISSING.hint: every ADR has one _index.md line: - [[ADR-NNN-slug]] - <y_statement> (new ADRs: FAIL)

ADR_INDEX_LINE_MISMATCH.hint: the _index.md line carries the y_statement verbatim after the dash

ADR_INDEX_SUFFIX_LENGTH.hint: the currency suffix after the y_statement stays under 60 characters

ADR_REVISIT_IF_MISSING.hint: add revisit_if: [code:.., data:.., external:.., date:YYYY-MM-DD] or revisit_if: none - <reason> (new ADRs: FAIL)

ADR_REVISIT_IF_REQUIRED.hint: a status: revisit ADR names its tripwire in revisit_if

ADR_REVISIT_IF_ITEM.hint: each item starts with code:, data:, external: or date:YYYY-MM-DD; the scalar form is none - <reason>

ADR_COMPLIANCE_FORMAT.hint: - Enforced by: hook|lint|test|type|schema|ci - `path` [`Symbol`], or - Enforced by: review - <what>

ADR_COMPLIANCE_PATH_MISSING.hint: the guard path no longer exists; update or remove the Compliance entry

ADR_COMPLIANCE_SYMBOL_MISSING.hint: the guard symbol is not at that path at HEAD

ADR_EXPIRES_PAST.hint: the transitional decision has expired; supersede, amend or extend expires

TOMBSTONE_FIELDS.hint: a retired non-decision note carries obsoletion_reason, retired: YYYY-MM-DD and exactly one of replaced_by / consider; use vault-refactor.sh retire

TOMBSTONE_POINTER_UNRESOLVED.hint: replaced_by / consider must name existing notes

TOMBSTONE_POINTER_CHAIN.hint: a tombstone points at a live note, never at another retired one

TOMBSTONE_BODY.hint: a retired non-decision note keeps only its banner and the History: line; prose lives in git history

LINK_TO_RETIRED.hint: point the link at the note the tombstone names instead

INDEX_LINE_CURRENCY_MISSING.hint: the index line of a superseded or deprecated ADR says so (- superseded by [[x]] / - deprecated)

CONFLICT_FORMAT.hint: conflicts_with is a flow list of quoted wikilinks: conflicts_with: ["[[other]]"]

CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED.hint: every conflicts_with entry names a live note

CONFLICT_ASYMMETRIC.hint: the other note carries the reciprocal conflicts_with entry; contested state is written on both sides

CONFLICT_UNBANNERED.hint: a note with conflicts_with opens with > Status: CONTESTED with [[other]] on <axis>

GLOSSARY_TERM_DUPLICATE.hint: one glossary entry per term; fold the second into the first

FRAGMENT_FORMAT.hint: a fragment lives under _fragments/<kind>/ with kind: and at: YYYY-MM-DD frontmatter; a ruling names exactly two [[notes]]

COVERAGE_EXCLUSION_FORMAT.hint: every exclusion is - `glob-or-symbol` - reason; an entry without the reason is not an exclusion
